open_points.subject: R0-12 versus A14 binary delivery failure classification
open_points.text: R0-12 says “a photo whose stored content cannot be delivered fails as a storage error”, while A14 says “A missing source object is an explicit unavailable/not-found failure”.
open_points.question: When an authorized, client-visible ProgressPhoto references missing stored content, is the result a storage error or an unavailable/not-found refusal?
options: Return the photo storage-error outcome required by changed R0-12.
Return the unavailable/not-found outcome required by A14.
open_points.default_guess: Treat changed R0-12 as the newer exception and return the photo storage-error outcome.

witness.initial: An active viewer has a valid grant to an active project and requests a client-visible ProgressPhoto whose record exists but whose referenced source object is missing.
events: The viewer requests the photo by photo_id.
The photo module authorizes the request and storage cannot find the referenced content.
outcomes: R0-12: the request fails as a storage error.
A14: the request fails as unavailable/not-found.
witness.observer: The authenticated caller sees the differing failure classification and its eventual HTTP mapping.

open_points.subject: Ownership of HTTP-safe DTO projection
open_points.text: The text says “Projection from persisted entities to these DTOs is owned by api only as a security allow-list”, then says “A safe view or result that an accepted use case returns itself … is built by that use case and passed through by the HTTP modules unchanged”; which DTOs qualify depends on whether a future State 5 operation names them as its output.
open_points.question: For each HTTP-safe view or mutation result, must State 5 name that DTO as the use-case output and make the use case build it, or may State 5 return persisted/domain records and leave the API to build the DTO under the preceding api-only rule?
options: Every safe DTO named in Projections and answers is built by its use case and passed through unchanged.
Only DTOs explicitly chosen as State 5 operation outputs are use-case-built; all others are projected by api.
The api remains the sole projection owner, and use cases return domain records despite the added sentence.
open_points.default_guess: Make use cases build DTOs explicitly named as their State 5 outputs; let api project only operations whose contracts return domain records.

witness.initial: An authenticated administrator creates a staff account successfully.
events: A State 5 author defines the create-staff operation and its return type.
An HTTP author serializes the successful result.
outcomes: The operation returns StaffAccountView, built by the use case, and the HTTP module passes it through unchanged.
The operation returns StaffAccount, and the HTTP module applies the security allow-list to construct StaffAccountView.
witness.observer: State 5 contract tests and module-boundary reviewers see different projection ownership, although the external JSON can be identical.
